title: Freeze Genesis protocol template
prediction: A frozen, validated protocol will reduce accounting and autonomy ambiguity before Day 1.
decision: Remain in readiness mode until every preflight item passes.
stop_condition: Do not start opportunity research before activation.

title: Publish frozen protocol and dashboard infrastructure

observed_facts: Max supplied https://github.com/mapzimus/Genesis for this implementation
The GitHub repository is public and has no remote branch
The local validator and fourteen acceptance tests pass
inferences: GitHub Pages can provide the required passive free static-hosting path without a domain purchase
unknowns: Whether the first Pages deployment will complete without an account-level setting change
contrary: A public repository creates passive visibility before Day 1

prediction: The frozen preregistration and redacted readiness dashboard will be publicly accessible without spending treasury funds.
decision: Publish the readiness repository to the supplied public remote and enable GitHub Pages for dashboard only.
stop_condition: Stop if the remote is nonempty, private access is broader than expected, validation fails, or any credential-like content is present.

title: Publish machine readiness and executable cycle gate

observed_facts: BRONTOSAURUS AC sleep and hibernate settings are already disabled
The system timezone is Eastern and the clock cross-check was within 1.47 seconds
Max instructed Codex to keep going
inferences: Publishing these non-sensitive readiness records improves audit continuity
unknowns: The future trusted Genesis project task ID
contrary: The public repository will temporarily contain readiness changes before the project task is opened

alternatives: Keep the changes only in the local worktree
prediction: The public repository will remain valid and the new cycle gate will block all scheduled work before full activation.
decision: Sync the machine evidence and executable cycle gate to the existing public Genesis repository.
stop_condition: Stop if validation or the credential scan fails, or if the remote branch diverges.

title: Migrate the protocol to the Claude platform and publish the v2.0.0 branch

observed_facts: Max directed in a Claude Code session on 2026-08-12 that the experiment move from Codex to Claude and that the cloud environment and owner-communication design be produced
Experiment status is readiness; Day 1 has not started and activation dates are unset
After the migration edits, the validator passes and all seventeen acceptance tests pass
A separate read-only cold-resume audit of the pre-publication tree returned FAIL; its blocking findings were fixed or are resolved by this publication (daily-reports/2026-08-12-migration-audit.md)
The v1.0.0 protocol remains unaltered in Git history and snapshots/
inferences: A pre-activation amendment is permitted because no strategic or metric rule changes and the experiment is not active
The ephemeral cloud runtime satisfies the protocol because cold-resumable pushed records were already the required discipline
unknowns: The merge timestamp of the amendment on main
Whether scheduled sessions can push directly to main, to be verified in the readiness dry runs
contrary: The v1.0.0 preregistration was already published as frozen, so any amendment weakens frozen-protocol optics even though the policy allows it before activation; mitigated by recording this as a numbered protocol event with v1.0.0 preserved

alternatives: Remain on Codex as originally preregistered
Abandon the v1 preregistration and republish a fresh protocol instead of amending
prediction: The branch publishes with a draft pull request, validation stays green, and the readiness gate continues to block Day 1 until Max merges and the checklist completes.
decision: Publish migration branch claude/agent-cloud-environment-990zct and open a draft pull request to main for Max's review.
stop_condition: Stop if validation or tests fail, the push is rejected, or credential-like content appears in the diff.

scope.content: Protocol v2.0.0: migrate platform from Codex to Claude, add cloud environment and communication design
